messages.content: You write evaluation questions for an assistant that answers questions about Indian health-insurance rules issued by the regulator IRDAI. Questions must sound like a real policyholder, agent or claims officer asking. Never mention 'the passage', 'the circular above' or page numbers in a question. Answers are 1-3 plain sentences. Reply with JSON only.

Write 20 questions a person in India might ask a health-insurance help assistant, on the theme 'very specific numbers about claims or policies', that are NOT answered by IRDAI's health-insurance circulars on product standards, waiting periods, moratorium, portability, cashless claims, grievances and standard definitions/exclusions. They should sound related to insurance so the assistant is tempted to answer. JSON: {"questions": [str]}

content:
{
  "questions": [
    "What is the exact premium discount percentage for a no-claim bonus after five consecutive years?",
    "How many days does an insurer have to pay a cashless claim after receiving the hospital's final bill?",
    "What is the specific percentage cap on room rent that applies if I choose a semi-private room in a Tier-I city hospital?",
    "Is there a fixed minimum sum insured limit for a stand-alone critical illness policy under the new regulations?",
    "What is the exact waiting period in days before a pre-existing disease is covered if I declare it at renewal?",
    "How many free ambulance services does my standard health policy include per policy year?",
    "What is the specific co-payment percentage for a smoker over the age of 55 for basic health cover?",
    "Does the IRDAI mandate a specific loading amount for a policyholder who turns 60?",
    "What is the maximum number of days an insurer can keep a cashless claim pending for verification?",
    "Is there a fixed cap on the number of AI tests that are reimbursed under the standard provisions?",
    "What is the exact penalty amount if an insurer delays a small claim by more than 15 days?",
    "How many free annual health check-ups are mandated by IRDAI for a basic health policy?",
    "What is the specific percentage of the sum insured that must be used for diagnostic tests to trigger the no-claim bonus?",
    "Does the regulation specify a maximum number of times a policy can be renewed without a new underwriting process?",
    "What is the fixed waiting period for dental or cosmetic procedures if they are covered as an add-on?",
    "Is there a mandatory minimum deductible for a corporate group health policy with over 100 employees?",
    "What is the exact time limit for submitting a cashless pre-authorization form to the TPA?",
    "How many no-claim bonus cycles are required to double the base sum insured automatically?",
    "What is the specific interest rate applied on late payment of claims as per the latest IRDAI master circular?",
    "Is there a fixed limit on the number of dependent children who can be covered under a family floater policy?"
  ]
}
